info.title: TechBridge messaging backend API
info.description: Documents the PR #22 messaging implementation and Phase 1 security policy. Common error envelopes are {success:false,message}; database outages are reported without internal details. Full HS256 bearer sessions with an expiry and current account/provider verification are required. Protected endpoints, including report creation/resolution, return Cache-Control: no-store. See security-hardening.md for shared parser errors and deployment settings. No production server or credential is embedded.

post.summary: Start or reuse a permitted conversation
post.description: Rechecks active accounts, current provider verification, both blocks, receiving preference and permitted student/provider relationship. Community contact requires current approved visible identity/consent and student initiation. Admins may initiate their own support conversation. Pair creation and the initiator quota serialize through account locks; no transcript access is granted to other admins. Maximum 10 newly initiated conversations/hour; existing reuse does not consume that allowance.

get.description: Only the authenticated participant?s conversations are returned. Search matches peer name/organization as a literal case-insensitive string, not a regular expression. The peer allowlist excludes email/contact details. Sorted by lastMessageAt, createdAt and ID descending; returns at most 20 rows per page. A deleted peer can be absent.

post.description: Participant-only, including administrators. Rechecks current permissions and community consent. Text is trimmed, 1?2000 characters; disallowed control characters are rejected. The message and conversation timestamp commit atomically. Shared account limits: 20/minute and 100/hour. Signals are best-effort after commit and contain no message body.

get.description: Participant-only even for administrators. History remains readable after a block or receiving opt-out while account authentication remains valid. Returns the latest/older 40 messages in chronological order. Use nextBefore for stable older pagination ordered by createdAt and ID. The legacy numeric page parameter is retained. Supplying both before and page, or a cursor belonging to another conversation, is invalid.

get.description: Authenticated fetch/SSE using Authorization: Bearer, never a token in the URL. There is no arbitrary room/user subscription. Refresh frames contain only type; typing frames contain conversationId and expiry epoch milliseconds. Full session expiry/version/status/provider verification is rechecked before every hint/heartbeat. Heartbeat refresh every 15 seconds, maximum lifetime five minutes; client reconnects and reads durable history. Limits are three streams/account/worker and 1000 total/worker. Slow consumers disconnect. Replica-set MongoDB change streams share temporary signals across workers; TTL expiry removes hints. No confidential message body is in this channel.

post.description: This document describes message complaints only; other existing report target types are unchanged. targetType must be message for this workflow, and targetId must be an incoming message in a conversation owned by the reporter. Self/foreign targets return 404, duplicate owner/target reports 409, maximum 10 message reports/day. This does not grant administrators transcript access.

post.description: Current active administrator only; complaint must be an open message report with valid participant provenance. Reporter and reported sender cannot review their own complaint. A 10?500 character access reason is required. MessageReviewAccess and AuditLog commit before evidence is returned; audit failure fails closed. Response excludes conversationId, neighboring messages and participant contact details. Closed complaints return 404.

patch.description: Documents the message-specific resolution contract; unrelated report types retain their original contract. Only an active independent administrator may act on an open complaint. A reviewed outcome requires that same actor?s recorded evidence access. A dismissed outcome requires a reason but may omit access. No private-message deletion is supported. Transactional decision/audit persistence; repeat/closed or unreviewed approval attempts return 409.

bearerAuth.description: Full HS256 session with integer expiry and valid platform claims only; provider-verification-only tokens are rejected. Single case-insensitive Bearer scheme, maximum 4096 header characters. Persisted roles, suspension, provider verification and token-version revocation remain authoritative.

ObjectId.description: MongoDB ObjectId in canonical hexadecimal form.
